# Test support for bolero work edit -toolchain to set toolchain to use

env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=local
env BOLERO_MODULE=on

! grep toolchain go.work
bolero work edit -toolchain=go1.9
grep 'toolchain go1.9' go.work

bolero work edit -toolchain=default
grep 'toolchain default' go.work

bolero work edit -toolchain=none
! grep toolchain go.work

-- go.work --
go 1.8
use .
-- go.mod --
module m
